focus: Anonymization on channel_messages with nil subject - does text_replacer crash?

summary.detail: The text_replacer method in CandidatesController#anonymize correctly handles nil, blank, empty-string, and whitespace-only subjects via the `text.blank?` early-return guard (line 228). Populated subjects containing candidate first/last names are correctly replaced with '*******' using case-insensitive gsub. The anonymization pattern at lines 146-147 (subject = text_replacer(subject, name, replacement)) works safely for all subject states. save!(validate: false) succeeds for all cases. No crashes, no unexpected type coercion, no data corruption.

test_results.detail: text_replacer('', ...) returned empty string as expected
text_replacer replaced candidate first name with '*******' correctly
nil subject survived text_replacer and save! without error
blank subject survived text_replacer and save! without error
populated subject anonymized correctly and persisted after reload
case-insensitive replacement works for UPCASE and downcase variants
3 messages with nil/blank/populated subjects all anonymized and saved successfully
whitespace-only subject returned unchanged (blank? guard works)
text_replacer with nil/empty old_word returns text unchanged
